download_hf_file: download a file from a Hugging Face Hub repository into the local cache directory
build_hf_hub_url: build a Hugging Face Hub URL for a given repo id, filename, and optional revision
fetch_file_metadata: fetch metadata such as etag, commit hash, and size for a file on the Hugging Face Hub
check_cache_file: check if a file exists in the local Hugging Face cache without raising exceptions
check_symlink_support: check whether symbolic links are supported in a given cache directory
